reviews.title: Great modular PSU with a small form factor
reviews.comment: I was on the hunt for a smaller PSU for my mATX gaming box. I paired this with a i5-9600k cpu and an Asus TUF GTX 1660 Super OC GPU. Love the modular design, will make hiding the cords easy. It is also quite. It comes with a plate to attach so you can use it in an ATX case, but check your sizes/cutouts of your case because it is a smaller form factor, ie the fan is smaller if you have a special cutout for a regular ATX sized fan, you may have gaps. It worked perfectly with mine. A bit on the higher price level, but I researched these fans and they are good quality with lots of good reviews. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Rodney SB

reviews.title: Best mix of price, power and size
reviews.comment: My external GPU system was unreliable. I needed a PSU this specific size, and more than 500W. This fit the bill, and now the graphics card is working perfectly. A little more expensive, but seems to have been worth it.
reviews.author: J. T. Kennedy

reviews.title: Good PSU from a Great Company
reviews.comment: FSP powersupplies are the only PSUs i've ever used. This is nothing short of the best. It's actually rated for it's advertised wattage. They are more expensive then other companies, and there's a reason. They are pretty much the only company that has any buisness being in the Powersupply game. Pros- SFX for Itx Builds, modular, 650w 80+gold, fan is quiet, and isn't even on until it starts heating up, which only happens of you're pushing it. Cons-Cables are way too long. The CPU 8pin is 700mm long, which is absolutely insane for an ITX build. It also is an 8 pin, with a 2nd 4+4 attached to it, which is dumb, again because it's ITX and there is no ITX motherboard that uses 8+4 or 8+8. The sata cables are both molex, and one has a floppy connector on it, so if you're running hardware that old, i guess thats okay. But again it's an ITX PSU, so there is once again no need for a 700mm cable with 100mm of cable between each connector. Other than that no problems.
reviews.author: Matthew Evans

reviews.title: Worst PSU's on the Market, two dead in 60 days.
reviews.comment: I've bought two of these in less than two months, they both have died. I purchased my first in December, it popped middle of February. In my haste to get back up and running and allowing time to rma the first psu, I purchased another thinking (rather hoping) the first was a fluke. these were the only psu's that were same day. this 2nd device barely lasted a week and popped last night. Been fighting to not upgrade away from small form factor machine, but the downside of limited availability and quantity really hurts, can't just go to best buy or anywhere and just grab one off the shelf.
reviews.author: LP
